items.title: OpenAI starts rolling out ChatGPT Space to Plus users, replacing Library
items.summary: OpenAI喺11月20日開始向全球18歲或以上嘅ChatGPT Plus用戶推出Space，用家可以同ChatGPT一齊製作互動頁面同簡報，邀請有Space權限嘅人共同編輯，亦可按已連接應用自動更新內容。Space會取代Library，可喺網頁、桌面應用同iOS、Android使用；免費用戶唔可以打開分享頁面，亦唔提供公開連結。
items.note: Source page lists the date only; exact publish time is unknown, so publishedAt uses T00:00+08:00.

items.title: OpenAI says new safeguards cut protected-reasoning extraction success to 0.2% on GPT-6.2 Astra
items.summary: OpenAI喺11月20日說明點樣偵測同阻截adversarial distillation，並加強保護模型內部思維鏈（protected reasoning），相關防護已應用於GPT-6.2 Astra同GPT-6.2 Sol。公司稱喺內部對抗評估中，攻擊成功率由GPT-6 Astra原有防護下嘅54.0%，降至更新防護後嘅GPT-6.2 Astra嘅0.2%。
items.note: Source page lists the date only; exact publish time is unknown, so publishedAt uses T00:00+08:00.
items.imageAlt: OpenAI social image for its adversarial distillation safeguards post

items.title: OpenAI introduces MedChemBench to test AI models on drug-candidate decisions
items.summary: OpenAI喺11月20日推出MedChemBench，用嚟測試AI模型閱讀分子結構、解讀實驗結果，以及決定下一步應該測試邊啲化合物嘅能力。
items.note: Source page lists the date only; exact publish time is unknown, so publishedAt uses T00:00+08:00.
items.imageAlt: OpenAI social image for the MedChemBench announcement

items.title: Google rolls out new Connected Apps in Search and Gemini for US holiday errands
items.summary: Google喺11月20日宣布，美國用戶可喺Search同Gemini應用透過新Connected Apps處理年終差事，包括用Albertsons、Safeway、Shaw's同Target買餸，並喺Search用Experian查信用評級同用H&R Block估算稅務。官方指Angi同Thumbtack將於未來數周加入Search。
items.note: Source page lists the date only; exact publish time is unknown, so publishedAt uses T00:00+08:00.
items.imageAlt: Google social image for the Connected Apps holiday-errands announcement

items.title: OpenAI adds GPT-Live-1.1 to the API for multilingual voice sessions
items.summary: OpenAI API更新列出，11月19日推出GPT-Live-1.1，改善多語語音對話嘅發音、口音一致性同轉錄表現，可喺現有Live session配置使用gpt-live-1.1。官方亦為GPT-Live-1同1.1嘅WebRTC session加入standby，冇活動時可暫停推論，有人講再恢復。
items.note: Source page lists the date only; exact publish time is unknown, so publishedAt uses T00:00+08:00.

items.title: OpenAI details Performance Factory, a Codex system that investigates ChatGPT slowdowns
items.summary: OpenAI喺11月19日介紹內部系統Performance Factory，用Codex代理自動調查同修復ChatGPT效能回退，工程師仍負責審批同部署。官方指第一個Regression Workflow喺三個幾月內跟進超過1,700宗調查，並找出超過600宗根因，平均每日約17宗自動調查。
items.note: Source page lists the date only; exact publish time is unknown, so publishedAt uses T00:00+08:00.
items.imageAlt: OpenAI social image for the Performance Factory announcement

items.title: Thinking Machines Lab releases Inkling 2 Mini as Apache-2.0 open weights for local use
items.summary: Thinking Machines Lab喺11月20日以Apache 2.0開放權重發布多模態模型Inkling 2 Mini，屬循環MoE架構，總參數約264億、每token約34億活躍參數，支援最長100萬token上下文，權重可喺Hugging Face下載。官方亦提供transformers、llama.cpp同MLX支援，方便本地運行。
items.note: Source page lists the date only; exact publish time is unknown, so publishedAt uses T00:00+08:00. Model card on thinkingmachines.ai also lists the Nov 20, 2026 release date and Apache 2.0 license.

items.title: Metric-AI releases OhanASR open-weight Armenian speech recognition models
items.summary: Metric-AI喺11月20日以CC BY-NC 4.0發布開權重亞美尼亞語語音識別模型OhanASR-v0.1，以及面向即時轉錄嘅OhanASR-Streaming-v0.1。官方稱v0.1喺ArmBench-ASR綜合WER為16.12%、CER為3.49%。
items.note: Source page lists the date only; exact publish time is unknown, so publishedAt uses T00:00+08:00.

items.title: Metric-AI releases Ayb 0.5, an open-source family of Armenian language models
items.summary: Metric-AI喺11月20日發布開源亞美尼亞語模型系列Ayb 0.5，包括Ayb-0.8B、Ayb-4B同Ayb-9B，建基於Qwen3.5架構，並已放上Hugging Face。官方指Ayb-9B喺ArmBench總分0.6164，係該系列最高，並稱在開源模型之中表現領先（不包括763B Deepseek）。
items.note: Source page lists the date only; exact publish time is unknown, so publishedAt uses T00:00+08:00.

items.title: NeuML releases Atto, a family of compact embedding models as small as 840 parameters
items.summary: NeuML嘅David Mezzetti喺11月19日發布Atto小型embedding模型系列，規模由840參數嘅ColBERT配置至2,800萬參數嘅dense模型，並已放上Hugging Face。文章稱9萬參數模型喺三個BEIR數據集嘅平均ndcg@10為0.4257，對比約2,300萬參數嘅all-MiniLM-L6-v2嘅0.4802。
items.note: Source page lists the date only; exact publish time is unknown, so publishedAt uses T00:00+08:00.

items.title: John Lee says AI should help build Northern Metropolis infrastructure
items.summary: 行政長官李家超喺11月20日國際基建卓越周2026開幕典禮表示，要建設北部都會區，香港必須以智慧城市理念、人工智能、先進工程技術、創新建造方法及材料，打造配合未來需要嘅基礎設施。發展局局長甯漢豪亦表示，提速推進北都時會精簡審批程序，並善用人工智能。政府新聞公報於香港時間19:25發出。
items.imageAlt: Official government photo from International Infrastructure Week 2026 in Hong Kong

items.title: CS Chan Kwok-ki chairs first meeting of Hong Kong's AI risk governance working group
items.summary: 政務司司長陳國基11月20日召開人工智能風險管治統籌工作組首次會議，檢視同統籌七項行動，包括打擊利用AI犯罪、加強保護未成年使用者、推動評估AI道德風險、促進行業安全應用、研究AI產品意外嘅法律責任、推出AI智能體管理指引，以及研究對就業嘅影響。政府新聞公報於香港時間13:13發出。
items.imageAlt: Official government photo from the AI risk governance working group meeting

items.title: The Verge: Reuters sources say SEC staff are scrutinizing potential accounting issues at Nvidia
items.summary: The Verge引述Reuters報道，兩名消息人士稱SEC執法人員正審視Nvidia可能存在嘅會計問題。報道指Nvidia周五收市報125.53美元，並稱股價連續第七周下跌；呢項調查未獲官方確認，唔代表已證實違規。
items.note: The accounting probe is attributed to Reuters sources and is unconfirmed by Nvidia or the SEC.
items.imageAlt: The Verge article image for Nvidia's stock slide and reported SEC scrutiny

items.title: TechCrunch: Bloomberg says Apple is developing a computer-use AI agent for Mac
items.summary: TechCrunch引述Bloomberg報道，Apple職位廣告顯示公司正開發可瀏覽網頁、操作應用、執行指令同寫code嘅電腦AI代理，進度仍屬早期，最早或於2027年底推出。報道亦指Apple計劃喺即將推出嘅macOS 27.3加強第三方代理權限警告；Apple未有回應TechCrunch查詢。
items.note: Based on a Bloomberg report cited by TechCrunch and a job listing; Apple did not comment. Publish time is 4:56 p.m. PST on Nov 19. The TechCrunch hero image was an unrelated cable photo, so imageUrl is null.

items.title: TechCrunch: Everful raises $48.5 million Series A to connect retailers with factories
items.summary: TechCrunch報道，前Alibaba高管Sisi Song同Kevin Han創立嘅Everful完成4,850萬美元A輪，由Vertex Ventures Southeast Asia & India同January Capital領投，Square Peg同Lightspeed跟投。公司稱每月向60多個國家運送超過500萬件貨，合作工廠逾3萬家，並目標年底達到1億美元年化收入。
items.imageAlt: Photo of Everful's founders from the TechCrunch article

items.title: Signal blocks screenshots on iOS 27 and some Android devices to stop OS AI agents reading chats
items.summary: Signal喺11月20日宣布，為防止作業系統內建AI代理擷取畫面，預設喺iOS 27，以及可偵測到AI助理嘗試擷取畫面嘅Android上封鎖截圖。用戶可喺設定關閉呢項保護，但官方警告咁做可能令對話內容暴露俾AI代理；目前未能喺macOS提供同等保護。
items.note: Source page lists the date only; exact publish time is unknown, so publishedAt uses T00:00+08:00.

items.title: Canva adds a toggle to turn off generative AI features for Free and Pro users

items.note: Valuation and total capital raised are from Linq's official blog at https://linqapp.com/blog/linq-raises-90m-welcomes-ben-horowitz-to-the-board. PR timestamp is Nov 18, 2026, 22:45 ET.

items.title: NVIDIA releases GeForce Hotfix Driver 621.35 to fix excessive SSD writes
items.summary: NVIDIA 已推出 GeForce Hotfix Driver 621.35，修復部分玩家在 621.14 同 621.24 驅動上遇到的背景過度寫入問題：背景程序可能反覆寫入 nvlog.nvlgstg，有用戶錄得每小時高達約 30GB 不必要寫入。此為可選的 beta 熱修復，適用於 Windows 10／11，修復稍後會納入尚未定檔的正式 WHQL 驅動。
items.note: VideoCardz stamp is 'Today, 22:12 GMT' on the Nov 20/21 page, treated as 2026-11-20T22:12:00Z = Nov 21, 06:12 HKT. NVIDIA Customer Care posted about 621.35 on November 20, 2026; bug reference 7116722 and the 30GB/hour figure are from VideoCardz, which also cites NVIDIA Support. Hotfix is optional/beta with abbreviated testing. imageUrl null: VideoCardz CDN returned HTTP 403 from this environment.

items.title: Atlus says it is working so the wait after Persona 6 will not be as long
items.summary: Persona Studio 總製作人和田和久在訪問中表示，團隊正製作《Persona 6》，可以公開的資訊仍然有限，但他們想透過作品證明至今的挑戰成果。他同時說《Persona 6》不是終點，團隊「正在做各種準備，確保下一作唔使再等得好像過去咁耐」。此報道沒有公布《Persona 6》發售日；Nintendo Everything 並提到 Switch 2 已有《Persona 3 Reload》，以及計劃中的《Persona 4 Revival》同未來的《Persona 6》。

Platforms list Switch 2 only because this article restates that Persona 6 is planned for Switch 2; it does not list other platforms in the new interview. items.title: US Nintendo Store says more Zelda 40th Anniversary Switch 2 consoles arrive in January 2027
items.summary: Nintendo Life 報道，美國 Nintendo 官方商店在 Zelda 40 週年 Switch 2 主機頁面寫明「more inventory is on the way in January 2027」，並可加入願望清單以便返貨時通知。報道指其他地區暫時未有同樣明確的補貨時間，因此趕唔及聖誕節前在美國官方店補貨。
items.note: Nintendo Life showed '10 hours ago' with no clock stamp when fetched around 08:00 HKT on Nov 21, so publishedAt is an approximate 22:00 HKT Nov 20. The January 2027 wording is from the US Nintendo Store as quoted by Nintendo Life, and applies to the US storefront only. imageUrl null: Nintendo Life og:image HTTP 403 from this environment.

items.title: Zenless Zone Zero version 3.4, The Finality of the Day, is dated December 2
items.summary: miHoYo 宣布，《Zenless Zone Zero》3.4 版本「The Finality of the Day」將於 12 月 2 日推出，Roscaelifer 主線迎來高潮，新的 Void Hunter／Enchainer 代理人 Sunbringer 參戰，三位 Sunbringer（Dracaene、Lindverne、Eldreda）首次並肩作戰。版本亦展開與《Honkai: Star Rail》連動，引入 Robin 同 Kafka，並有新戰鬥玩法同常駐模式更新。
items.note: Gematsu stamp Nov 20, 2026, 8:05 AM EST = Nov 20, 21:05 HKT. Platforms are the 2026 live-game set reported on official HoYoverse / ZZZ site coverage (PS5, PC including Steam, Xbox Series X|S); this 3.4 article itself did not relist platforms. Mobile was not confirmed in the official-site sources opened this run, so it is not listed. imageUrl null: Gematsu og:image HTTP 403 from this environment.

items.title: Temtem: Swarm is dated January 21, 2027 for Switch
items.summary: 開發商 Crema 同 GGTech Studios 宣布，類 Survivor 動作遊戲《Temtem: Swarm》將於 2027 年 1 月 21 日登陸 Switch。遊戲已於 2024 年 11 月 13 日在 Steam 搶先體驗，並在 2026 年 4 月 2 日以完整版登陸 PS5 同 PC。此報道只公布 Switch 版，未有提及 Switch 2。
items.note: Gematsu stamp Nov 20, 2026, 8:00 AM EST = Nov 20, 21:00 HKT. The January 21, 2027 date is for the Switch version; PS5 and PC already launched April 2, 2026. imageUrl is the official Steam header for app 2510960 (HTTP 200).
items.imageAlt: Steam header art for Temtem: Swarm

items.title: Dual Orb Collection is dated March 18, 2027 for Switch in Japan
items.summary: Mebius 宣布《Dual Orb Collection》將於 2027 年 3 月 18 日在日本登陸 Switch，收錄 Super Famicom 角色扮演遊戲《Dual Orb: Seireiju Densetsu》（1993）同續作《Dual Orb II》（1994）。8,800 日圓的限定實體版會附兩枚原聲 CD。
items.note: Gematsu stamp Nov 19, 2026, 11:55 PM EST = Nov 20, 12:55 HKT. Japan-only date in the article; no other regions mentioned. imageUrl null: Gematsu og:image HTTP 403 from this environment.

items.title: Saihate Station: Twilight Edition is dated March 25, 2027 for Switch
items.summary: 發行商 PLAYISM 同開發商 viv 宣布，《Saihate Station: Twilight Edition》將於 2027 年 3 月 25 日全球登陸 Switch，收錄本體、「Twilight Railway」DLC 同兩款迷你遊戲。這是 2D 探索恐怖冒險，有四條結局路線；日本實體版預購由 11 月 20 日起陸續開始。
items.note: Gematsu stamp Nov 19, 2026, 11:04 PM EST = Nov 20, 12:04 HKT. Worldwide Switch date is from Gematsu. imageUrl is the official Steam header for the existing PC game (app 3079280, HTTP 200).
items.imageAlt: Steam header art for Saihate Station

items.title: Xenoblade Chronicles 3 version 3.0.0 is live ahead of the Switch 2 Edition on December 3
items.summary: Nintendo 同 Monolith Soft 已推出《Xenoblade Chronicles 3》版本 3.0.0（11 月 19 日），為 12 月 3 日推出的 Switch 2 Edition 作準備。官方支援頁指，此更新令遊戲兼容 Switch 2 Edition；在原版 Switch 上遊玩則「沒有變更」。Switch 2 Edition 會加入新英雄 Shimmer、專屬模式 Heroes' Vault，並支援電視模式 4K、60fps，以及英日文完整配音過場；由 Switch 版升級售 9.99 美元／7.99 英鎊。
items.note: Nintendo Life dateline is 3:15am on Friday 20 Nov 2026; the site is UK-based and the UK was on GMT, so 03:15 UTC = 11:15 HKT. The patch itself is dated 19 November 2026 on Nintendo's support page, which Nintendo Life quotes. Upgrade price $9.99 / £7.99 is from Nintendo Life. imageUrl null: Nintendo Life og:image HTTP 403 from this environment.

items.title: Toby Fox says Deltarune Chapter 6 is a structurally complete draft, and Chapter 7 has only just begun
items.summary: Toby Fox 在 Fall 2026 電子報表示，《Deltarune》Chapter 6「進展順利」，而家已是可由頭玩到尾的「結構完整草稿」，但部分重要場景同細節仍未完成，距離全面測試「還要再一段時間」，他強調唔會趕工。Chapter 7 團隊「剛剛開始」；Fox 向團隊朗讀部分事件同對白後在關鍵處停下，等他們完成更多內容才續講。下次更新會在 Chapter 6 本地化完成時公布。
items.note: Nintendo Life dateline is 2:30am on Friday 20 Nov 2026 (treated as 02:30 GMT = 10:30 HKT). It cites toby.fangamer.com. The article does not give a Chapter 6 release date; do not invent 2027. Platforms are the current official DELTARUNE set as listed on deltarune.com / Steam / Gematsu (PC, Switch, Switch 2, PS5) as of the Chapter 5 launch coverage. imageUrl is the official Steam header for app 1671210 (HTTP 200).
items.imageAlt: Steam header art for DELTARUNE

items.title: Caladrius 2/Dark Element is delayed from December 10 to January 27, 2027
items.summary: 發行商 H2 Interactive 同 MOSS 旗下 Kaminari Games 將射擊續作《Caladrius 2/Dark Element》由原定 2026 年 12 月 10 日延期至 2027 年 1 月 27 日全球發售，平台為 PS5、Switch 同 Steam 版 PC。為符合平台指引，PS5 版的「Malice」遮蔽效果同部分解除選項會與其他平台有差異，但官方指不影響玩法同平衡。
items.note: Gematsu stamp Nov 19, 2026, 8:36 PM EST = Nov 20, 09:36 HKT, after the Nov 20 batch was generated. imageUrl null: Gematsu og:image HTTP 403 from this environment.

items.title: IGN and Rockstar publish a free official online strategy guide for GTA 6
items.summary: GamesIndustry.biz 報道，母公司 IGN Entertainment 已與 Rockstar Games 直接合作，在 IGN.com 推出免費《Grand Theft Auto VI》官方線上攻略，包括以 MapGenie 製作的互動地圖、任務清單，以及任務、系統同開放世界指南，並計劃在發售後持續更新。IGN 表示目標之一是在協助玩家之餘保持避免劇透的體驗。
items.note: GamesIndustry.biz stamp Nov. 20, 2026, 10:07 a.m. (UK, GMT) = 18:07 HKT. IGN Entertainment is the parent company of GamesIndustry.biz, which the article discloses. Platforms follow the current GTA 6 console release (PS5 and Xbox Series). imageUrl is the article og:image (HTTP 200).

items.title: 12 more Baldur’s Gate 3 mods are approved for PS5 and Xbox Series
items.summary: VGC 報道，又有 12 款《Baldur’s Gate 3》模組通過審核，可在 PS5 同 Xbox Series 下載，先前只在 PC 提供。新批次包括新法術、自動拾取、提高首領生命，以及建基於 Tactician 的新難度 Brutal Difficulty 等；主畫面選單會進入由 mod.io 驅動的模組頁，模組通常約每週批准一批。
items.note: VGC stamp 19th Nov 2026 / 6:09 pm (UK, GMT) = Nov 20, 02:09 HKT. The article lists 12 named mods plus a 13th line in its bullet list ('Permanent Blessings of Shar'); the headline and lede say 12, so the summary follows VGC's '12 new mods' count and does not treat the extra bullet as a confirmed 13th approval. imageUrl null: VGC og:image HTTP 403 from this environment.

items.title: Ampere Analysis: more than 2 million US and UK players accessed GTA 6 early by switching regions
items.summary: Ampere Analysis 向 GamesBeat 提供的數據顯示，在 11 月 19 日當地午夜正式開賣前，美國約有 150 萬、英國約有 60 萬名玩家，透過把主機地區設成紐西蘭等地，提早遊玩《Grand Theft Auto VI》。GamesBeat 指 Xbox 較易在主機設定改地區，因此用量明顯高過 PlayStation；PS5 玩家要另開紐西蘭區 PSN 帳號並在該帳號購買遊戲。
items.note: GamesBeat stamp 2026-11-19T15:50:13+00:00 = Nov 19, 23:50:13 HKT. Figures are Ampere Analysis estimates shared with GamesBeat, not official Rockstar/Take-Two numbers: about 1.5 million in the US and 600,000 in the UK. The article explains the Xbox vs PS5 difference but does not give a precise per-platform split in the text quoted here. Missed by the Nov 20 morning batch; still within the 48-hour window. imageUrl is the article image (HTTP 200).
items.imageAlt: A scene from Grand Theft Auto VI

items.summary: Game Studio 宣布，恐怖 RPG《Ao Oni: The Horror of Blueberry Onsen Plus》同《Ao Oni 2》將於 12 月 17 日登陸 PS5。前者已於 2025 年 4 月 25 日登陸 Switch、5 月 1 日登陸 Steam；《Ao Oni 2》則已於 2026 年 8 月 6 日登陸 Switch 同 Steam。

items.title: Comcast says GTA 6 preloads made November 18 its busiest internet day, and Circana logs huge launch engagement
items.summary: GameSpot 報道，Comcast 宣布 11 月 18 日（預載最後一日）是該公司有史以來互聯網流量最高的一天，峰值較平常高出 31%，並較先前最高紀錄再高 9.6%；當天約 24% 網絡流量來自下載或遊玩 GTA 6，而且 GTA 6 已佔 Comcast 有史以來最繁忙 10 日的其中 5 日。Circana 的 Mat Piscatella 則指，11 月 19 日美國 61% 活躍 PS5 帳號有遊玩 GTA 6，全球則有 56% Xbox 玩家參與，當日平均遊玩時間分別約 513 分鐘同 494 分鐘。
items.note: GameSpot stamp November 20, 2026 at 11:52AM PST = Nov 21, 03:52 HKT. Comcast figures and the Circana/Piscatella engagement numbers are as reported by GameSpot. 'Engaged with' is Circana's wording for active accounts on November 19. imageUrl is the article image (HTTP 200).
items.imageAlt: Circana chart accompanying GameSpot’s GTA 6 records report

items.title: Take-Two says GTA 6 did $3.79 billion in day-one retail sales after 32.5 million pre-orders
items.summary: Take-Two／Rockstar 宣布，截至 11 月 19 日全球日終的公司估計，《Grand Theft Auto VI》首日零售銷售額達 37.9 億美元，稱之為史上最大型娛樂作品開賣成績；預售量為 3,250 萬套，同屬新紀錄。遊戲現於 PS5 同 Xbox Series 發售，官方並指 Metacritic 評分接近滿分的 99。
items.note: Official Take-Two / Business Wire release dated Nov. 20, 2026, with no clock time on the IR page. publishedAt uses Gematsu's stamp for the same announcement (Nov 20, 2026, 2:35 PM EST = Nov 21, 03:35 HKT). The $3.79 billion figure is 'day one retail sales' based on company estimates through end of day November 19 worldwide, per the asterisk in the release. 32.5 million is pre-release units sold. This supersedes earlier third-party estimates in prior batches. imageUrl is the official multimedia image on the IR page (HTTP 200).
items.imageAlt: Official Grand Theft Auto VI key art from Take-Two

items.title: GameStop CEO Ryan Cohen says going all-digital has hurt consumers and GameStop
items.summary: PC Gamer 引述 Bloomberg 訪問，GameStop 行政總裁 Ryan Cohen 在《GTA 6》數位發行前夕表示：「當你買遊戲，應該可以轉售、換購或者借俾朋友。」他認為全面數位化「無疑傷害了消費者，也傷害了 GameStop」。Cohen 沒有點名《GTA 6》，但稱已同「顯而易見」的發行商談過；他認為發行商不喜歡二手市場，因為收走二手拷貝就等於少了一個不買新品的選擇。
items.note: PC Gamer stamp 2026-11-20T16:45:10Z = Nov 21, 00:45:10 HKT, citing a Bloomberg interview on the eve of GTA 6. Cohen did not namecheck GTA 6, as the article notes. Platforms reflect the digital-only GTA 6 launch context of the piece. imageUrl is the article og:image (HTTP 200).
items.imageAlt: Portrait of GameStop CEO Ryan Cohen
